name: B10-0478/2026 (PPE) – Escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns deadly Russian attacks on civilian merchant ships in the Black Sea near Bulgaria and Romania. It says Russia is responsible for destabilising trade, the economy and tourism in the region. It asks the European Union and its member states to consider sending an EU naval operation to the Black Sea, to work with NATO on defending the area, and to spend more on defence in the region. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU to consider a Black Sea naval operation and more defence spending.
- **Who it affects:** Bulgaria, Romania, Black Sea shipping, and EU and NATO defence planning.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to EU leaders, the Commission, NATO and others for them to act on.
